target_customer: Knowledge workers and researchers who follow newsletters, papers and podcasts
problem: Staying on top of a field means scanning many sources; the app turns long content into short LLM insights in one feed.
business_model: Consumer mobile app, monetisation not stated (beta)

founders.name: Marie van der Klink
founders.background_notes: YC page; experience in software and UI/UX design. The two founders previously worked together on a research app for students and researchers.

founders.name: Carine Fattal
education: Imperial College London, master's in design engineering
founders.background_notes: YC page; mobile app development and interaction design.

competitors.name: feeeed
competitors.what: Reader app going beyond RSS with source suggestions and an AI bot

technical_complexity.rationale: A mobile app that ingests sources and summarizes with LLMs is standard engineering in 2024; quality of extraction is the hard part.

defensibility.rationale: Summarization feeds are easy to copy and rely on third party models and content.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Many news and feed apps added AI summaries; Artifact was discontinued per a comparison page. No direct action against et al. found.

market_need_then: Information overload and rising LLM use; no et al. specific demand evidence found beyond the founders' prior research app.

identity.voice_and_tone: light, Scroll smarter, ties the name to ancient scrolls

branding.brand_signature: Scroll smarter and bringing knowledge back on a scroll

brand_strength.rationale: Academic wink in the name and a clear tagline, but hard to search and no press or community evidence found.

outcome_analysis: et al. is a two person YC S24 London team with a beta mobile feed app. No funding, news, shutdown or acquisition was found, so the outcome is unknown. The category is crowded and easy to copy, which is a risk, but nothing in sources shows traction or failure.
notes: Directories conflict on location (London vs United States). Funding search found nothing for this company. Site is in beta.
